[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for recovery after an intense workout, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Stretching and Foam Rolling: Focus on major muscle groups like legs, glutes, and calves for 10-15 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hydration: Drink 16-20 ounces of fluid for every pound of body weight lost during the run.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Protein and Carbohydrates: Consume a balanced meal or snack within 30-60 minutes after the run.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Rest and Ice: Take a few days off from intense exercise and apply ice packs to sore areas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Compression and Elevation: Wear compression socks and elevate legs to reduce inflammation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Active Recovery: Engage in low-intensity activities like walking, cycling, or swimming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Sleep and Relaxation: Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep and practice relaxation techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Massage and Self-Myofascial Release: Use tools like a lacrosse ball or tennis ball for muscle tension.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Gradual Return to Training: Resume training gradually, starting with shorter, easier runs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Listen to Your Body: Pay attention to signals like persistent pain or fatigue.
